For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Count the number of items in an input list, rows in a table, or bytes in binary data.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> length {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input              | output |
| ------------------ | ------ |
| list&lt;any&gt;          | int    |
| binary             | int    |
| nothing            | int    |
| SQLiteQueryBuilder | int    |
## Examples

Count the number of items in a list
```nu
> [1 2 3 4 5] | length
5
```

Count the number of rows in a table
```nu
> [{a:1 b:2}, {a:2 b:3}] | length
2
```

Count the number of bytes in binary data
```nu
> 0x[01 02] | length
2
```

Count the length a null value
```nu
> null | length
0
```
